newsitem.title: USA: Ahmanson asks Great Western for record date.
newsitem.headline: Ahmanson asks Great Western for record date.

text.p: H.F. Ahmanson and Co said Friday it sent a written request for Great Western Financial Corp to fix a record date, no later than 10 days from today, for Ahmanson's proposed consent solicitation.

Ahmanson said it made the request in response to Great Western's decision to amend its by-law concerning consent solicitations, which would give its board 10 days to set a record date after receiving a consent solicitation. This effectively slowed down a consolidation solicitation, which occurs when a shareholder, such as Ahmanson, calls for a shareholder vote on various proposals.
